summary: Narrow access lane to houses and the canoe club, with no stopping signed.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign on the lane
Narrow lane, nowhere to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the north side, but dwellings sit 8 m and 11 m from the line on the south side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane serving houses and the canoe club, with vehicles already parked at its edge; no spare width to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane that ends at the canoe club and the pedestrian bridge.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign 0.7 m from the line; no clear parking convention.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of the line
Low-lying near Witton Creek, 32 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy covers the north side; the lane gets afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is public or private
